# Contract fixtures

Pinned response bodies from NENE2 `docs/openapi/openapi.yaml` examples (system routes).

Update when the upstream OpenAPI example values change.

1. Edit the JSON fixture(s).
2. Bump `openapi-pin.txt` (`revision` date + note).
3. Run `npm run check`.

See `docs/development/openapi-contract-testing.md` for the full checklist.
